sourceTitle: John Brown: An Address at the 14th Anniversary of Storer College
description: "John Brown: An Address at the 14th Anniversary of Storer College" by Frederick Douglass is a historical account delivered in the late 19th century. This address, presented to commemorate John Brown's legacy, focuses on his role as a controversial figure in the fight against slavery and his raid on Harper's Ferry in 1859.
